faq.title: Help & FAQ
faq.subtitle: Answers regarding safety, usage and privacy
faq.intro_banner: Here you will find plain answers to the most common questions about SeniorConnect.
faq.a_how_to_request: Tap 'Request Help' on the home screen, select the matching category, and specify when you need support.
faq.a_safety_trust: All volunteers are registered with verified phone numbers and agreed to our community guidelines. For sensitive tasks, they are additionally verified by local organizations.
faq.a_family_access: Yes, with the 'Access Card for Relatives' you can connect trusted family members so they can coordinate requests on your behalf.
faq.q_notifications: How many notifications will I receive?
faq.a_notifications: We protect your peace of mind: at most 2 non-urgent notifications per day. Night hours (20:00 - 08:00) are quiet hours.
faq.a_privacy_gdpr: Your data remains in Switzerland/EU and is never sold to advertisers. You can export or delete your data anytime.
faq.q_emergency_144: What should I do in an emergency?
faq.a_emergency_144: In case of acute medical emergencies or immediate danger, call 144 (Ambulance) or 112 (General Emergency) immediately.
faq.personal_help_desc: Our support team or a local coordination office is happy to assist you.
faq.support_contacted: Thank you. A representative will get in touch.

location_sharing.title: Who can see where I live?
location_sharing.settings_subtitle: Choose how precisely others see where you live.
location_sharing.intro: You decide how much others learn about where you live. SeniorConnect always uses your address to find help nearby – who sees what of it is up to you.
location_sharing.none_desc: Others only see roughly how far away you are (for example "1 to 3 km"). Neither your town nor your address.
location_sharing.approximate_desc: Others also see your municipality and postal code. Never your street or house number.
location_sharing.precise_title: Exact location for an agreed visit
location_sharing.precise_desc: Only the person currently assigned to your request may see your exact location on a map – to find their way to you. Nobody else, not even an organisation.
location_sharing.precise_confirm_body: The helper assigned to your request will then see your exact location on a map. You can turn this off here at any time – it applies immediately.
location_sharing.version_outdated: The explanation has been updated. Please read it and choose again.
location_sharing.footnote: Change your choice at any time. Turning sharing off applies to everyone immediately.
location_sharing.visit_address_body: Once someone has firmly taken on your request, only that person gets your visit address – so they can find you. If the request is cancelled, they no longer see it. Organisations do not see it. This applies regardless of the setting above.
location_sharing.visit_address_grant_title: Share your address for this visit?
location_sharing.visit_address_grant_body: Your visit address is confidential. By granting, the assigned person may see it for THIS visit only – and only until check-in. A new assignment starts without a grant. You can revoke it any time before check-in.
location_sharing.visit_address_grant_active_body: The assigned person can see your visit address for this visit. You can revoke it any time before check-in.
location_sharing.visit_address_grant_revoked: Grant revoked. The address is no longer shared.

discovery_settings.title: Can people find me?
discovery_settings.settings_subtitle: Whether your profile appears when people look for helpers.
discovery_settings.switch_desc: Your profile appears in searches near you – with a rough distance, never your address.
discovery_settings.not_location: Being findable does not mean anyone sees where you live. You decide that separately under "Who can see where I live?".
